facts.fact: 莉莉向厨房台面上的 AI 伴侣 Ariel 问时间，Ariel 回答“晚上 8:17”，并指出这是她 15 分钟内第三次问。
facts.anchor: “I’m always happy to help you, Lily. It is eight-seventeen p.m. That is the third time you asked in the last fifteen minutes.”

facts.fact: 奶奶 Nan 在给莉莉的信里说自己一直“暗中时常关注”她的近况，还夸她正长成聪明有趣的姑娘。
facts.anchor: I discreetly check in on you every now and then. It’s plain as day that you’re turning into a smart and interesting young lady!

facts.fact: 山姆承认偷拿了爸爸的手机（妈妈的没找到）——为的是从新交的高中生朋友那里拿到骑乘设施的“秘密全通证”。
facts.anchor: “Well, I couldn’t find hers, so I took Dad’s,” Sam admitted.

facts.fact: 莉莉把“Nan 将来 Paradise 搞惊喜家庭团聚”的事告诉山姆，他只丢下一句“知道了，再见”就朝门口走去——今晚去 Macaw Falls 夜游。
facts.anchor: “Good to know. See ya!” Sam said, heading for the door.

facts.fact: 山姆再次提醒莉莉：不必靠他和乔丹帮自己“走出内耗”来享受这里——记住两人的约定，Paradise 的体验由你自己决定。
facts.anchor: “You don’t need me or Jordan to help you get out of your head for a while and enjoy this place. Remember the pact.

facts.fact: 米洛自述父母分手后，他跟着当老师、爱旅行的爸爸加入了名为 Wandering Scholars 的沉浸式游学团体（在家上学至少两年）。
facts.anchor: After he and my mom split up, the two of us became part of this immersive learning collective called Wandering Scholars.

facts.fact: 占卜师 Estrella 压低声音警告莉莉和米洛：岛上事情并不像表面那样，好奇心虽可贵但可能招来大麻烦，务必小心。
facts.anchor: “Things aren’t what they seem on the island. Your curiosity is admirable, but it could get you in big trouble. Be careful. Both of you,”

facts.fact: 章末莉莉感叹乔丹说得对——不去尝试就真的会错过。
facts.anchor: And Jordan was right, too. You really do miss out when you don’t try.
